validity.researcher_notes: South Jersey Gas Pipeline is a confirmed intrastate NJ project documented in EIA from May 2019 onwards. Status changed from Approved/On Hold to Denied in Jan 2026 release. EIA row shows: 22 mi, 24 in diameter, 53 MMcf/d capacity, $90M cost. Operator: South Jersey Gas. Authority: Pinelands Commission. Project Notes state permitting was suspended by NJDEP in July 2020 due to environmental concerns, serving B.L. England power plant. No FERC docket (intrastate). All sheet values match EIA. No independent sources consulted yet for second corroboration. Status: sheet says 'cancelled', EIA says 'Denied' (equivalent).
